project.title: NEEDLE: permission-aware hybrid retrieval in Db2
project.short_description: NEEDLE maps a vague security report to the services it affects: one Db2 SQL PL call fuses BM25 keyword rank (plain SQL) and DiskANN vector rank (FETCH APPROX on a vector index) with reciprocal rank fusion under row and column access control, and an exact SBOM join with BUSINESS_TIME history says which services are affected and since when. NEEDLE measures what row permissions do to approximate vector search: every user shares one plan with a constant observed optimizer estimate (filter factor 0.495), the index over-fetches by 1/FF, and a user who sees 10% of the rows gets 2.05 of 10 rows (recall 0.205). On 89 held-out queries, the vector leg of a per-user router restores recall to 0.987-1.000 and returns 10 of 10 rows, with 0 leaks.

features_used: VECTOR(768, FLOAT32) NOT NULL and VECTOR_DISTANCE (COSINE)
CREATE VECTOR INDEX (DiskANN) with FETCH APPROX / FETCH EXACT and literal k
BM25 keyword ranking in plain SQL (inline SQL table function over postings tables)
SQL PL stored procedure: both legs and reciprocal rank fusion in one statement
JSON_VALUE with a recursive common table expression for bound query terms
Row and column access control: CREATE PERMISSION on 4 tables, CREATE MASK
Application-period temporal table (PERIOD BUSINESS_TIME, WITHOUT OVERLAPS)
Raw JSON in CLOB with SHA-256 provenance
